name: Mitten Extracts | 3g Max Pro Disposable | Watermelon Z
description:
Juicy, sweet, and refreshingly smooth, Watermelon Z delivers bold watermelon flavor with subtle candy-like notes in every pull. This Max Pro disposable offers a perfectly balanced experience, blending bright fruit flavor with a mellow, relaxing vibe that’s easy to enjoy anytime.

Packed with 3G of Liquid Diamonds + Live Resin terpenes for a smooth, powerful experience that lasts. Fine-tune every hit with Flavor, Balance, or Clouds mode.
